spec: DATA_MODEL.md §18 module 11 — fomc_meetings 8; DATA_MODEL.md L2082 "from fed.fomc calendar page (curated fixture for 2026)".
note: Hand-curated because no fed.fomc capture exists in fixtures/providers/raw: the 2026 calendar page was never recorded, and a fixture miss is a wall (FEED-08), so the eight meetings are transcribed from the published Federal Reserve calendar instead of fetched. fomc_meetings.provenance_id is therefore NULL for these rows, which the column permits (0009_econ_curves.sql) precisely for a curated source — WIRP's policy-path nodes are dates, not values, and DATA-10 constrains seeded *values*.
decisionNote: decision_bp is deliberately absent from every row. The column is "filled after the meeting" (0009_econ_curves.sql) and no recorded fixture carries an FOMC decision, so the seed writes NULL rather than a plausible -25. WIRP reads the nodes; it does not read a number we invented.
